apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: Movies & TV has been redone: Continue watching at the top, Movies on the left and TV Shows on the right, each opening its own page. New lists: Top new movies, In cinemas, Coming soon (with release dates), New seasons, Top rated, Kids & family, Crime & drama and Genres. A show's page now says when its next episode is on.
Samsung TV Plus movie channels that won't play in Australia are no longer listed.
